The *Phassādivinibbhujanapañha* ("The Question on Unblending Experience", Mil 3.4.1) is a dialogue belonging to the *Milindapañha* collection [SuttaCentral]. Modern translations of the text include an English translation by John Kelly, alongside three other translations in three languages cataloged on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].

SuttaCentral identifies a curated full parallel in the Chinese canon at T 1670b 2.35 ("Inseparability of Dharmas") [SuttaCentral]. Furthermore, automated text-reuse analysis by DharmaNexus identifies matching passages shared between the *Phassādivinibbhujanapañha* and five Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial overlap is with the *Mahāvedalla Sutta* of the Majjhima Nikāya (MN 43), comprising 20 matching passages (notably the alignment of §1.2_0–1.2_1 with MN 43 §9.3–9.4) [DharmaNexus].
